shared_or_similar_visual_information: Decimal notations differing only by a minus sign: 8.5 and −8.5.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The corresponding triangle side has positive length value 8.5. Right image: The function's trough point has negative y-coordinate −8.5.
Rationales: The minus sign changes the complete numerical value; a side length and a y-coordinate also serve different roles.
